assessment_scope: Bounded mathematical audit, not a full manuscript or PDF assessment.

A.closure: Correct CMI DPI acts on R, not B. Finite reference entropy and finite partitions justify infinite-entropy resets and continuous heterodyne.

B.closure: Exact occupation-product and radical identities; explicit remainder integral proves gap uniform in E,t; k=1 treated separately.

C.closure: One finite cq alphabet of local mixed letters, fixed physical output cutoff, original spectral-tail image bound, and exact type-superletter cost. Supplied explicit budget-uniform m/cut/error choices.

D.closure: Unassisted<=EA and common unassisted achievable rate sandwich both deficits. Only worst-pair Gaussian gap must vanish.

E.closure: Supplied uniform finite-output approximation at fixed E,N via thermal-reference compression, even N>>E; bounded-G strata yield one common strict rate and necessity.

F.closure: Known mechanisms acknowledged; bounded antecedent search supplies no priority certificate. No small-budget necessity, bounded-bath sufficiency or critical curve asserted.

validated_regimes.known_signal: fixed0<k<1; under n(E)->infinity complete curves hold iff n=o(E). Necessity does not require that premise.
validated_regimes.unknown_signal: fixed k0>0, k in[k0,1], n in[0,N(E)]; under N(E)->infinity complete curves hold iff N=o(E). Actual members need not have divergent n.
validated_regimes.budget: all finite B>=0 uniformly; alpha=1 or a fixed finite alpha>1.
validated_regimes.operational: No preshared entanglement; local mixed/product preparations, collective quantum receiver, known optical phase, fixed memoryless channel within each code, expected photon block cost, average-message error.
